# Contributing

This is a personal fork of [wezterm](https://github.com/wezterm/wezterm), and it
doesn't really take contributions. Pull requests and feature requests here are
unlikely to be picked up.

If you'd like to improve wezterm, please contribute to upstream instead:

- Code, docs and bug reports: <https://github.com/wezterm/wezterm>
- Upstream's contributing guide:
  <https://github.com/wezterm/wezterm/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md>

That way everyone using wezterm benefits, and the changes flow into this fork
too when it's rebased onto upstream.

You're also welcome to upstream any of this fork's changes yourself; see the
[README](../README.md) for what they are.
